# Twitter / X — 2015

Volume drops. YouTube playlist adds, O&A residue, and the flat New Year's 'another year. woo yay other exciting things' — the year the Annie relationship starts in November is almost silent on this account, which is itself a finding: Twitter is not where that year was lived.
